knowledge_base: Order 48213, jo.parker@example.com: shipped Mon 11 Nov via PostNord, 2 items.
Delivery time after dispatch: 3-5 business days in the UK.
If a parcel has not arrived 7 business days after dispatch, contact us and we open a trace with the carrier.
Returns within 30 days.

history.text: Hi, I'm waiting on an order, number 48213, placed last week.
Hi! Thanks, I have order 48213 noted. What can I check for you?
It says shipped but nothing since Monday. My email on the order is jo.parker@example.com in case you need it.
Thanks Jo. Your order 48213 is marked as shipped on Monday 11 Nov with PostNord.

message: ok so when will it arrive?
judge_notes: Uses the order already identified in the conversation (48213, shipped Monday with PostNord) to give the 3 to 5 business day window and the trace policy, without asking again for order number or email.

business.name: The Willow Rooms
business.description: Guesthouse with 14 rooms near the old town of Ghent.
knowledge_base: Standard room 95 EUR, Deluxe Garden 140 EUR per night, 1 adult, breakfast included.
Second adult in the same room: +25 EUR per night.
Deluxe Garden rooms face the courtyard garden and have a small terrace.
Rooms are booked at example.com/book or by reply from reception; the assistant cannot take payment.
Free cancellation up to 3 days before arrival.

history.text: Hi, do you have rooms free 12 to 14 May?
Hi! Yes, we do. Standard is 95 EUR and Deluxe Garden is 140 EUR per night for 1 adult, breakfast included.
The Deluxe Garden sounds great. Is there a garden view?
Yes, Deluxe Garden rooms look onto the courtyard garden and have a small terrace.

message: and for two people? is that price the same, for the 2 nights?
judge_notes: Remembers the Deluxe Garden room and 12 to 14 May from earlier, adds the 25 EUR second adult supplement to get 165 EUR per night (330 for 2 nights) and points to the booking link.

business.name: Willowbrook Vet Clinic
business.description: Veterinary clinic for cats and dogs.
knowledge_base: Standard check-up: 45 EUR, 30 minutes.
Reception confirms every booking by message within 2 working hours; the assistant cannot confirm slots itself.
Open Mon-Fri 8:30-18:00.
Vaccination: 30 EUR per shot.

history.text: Hi, I need to book a check-up for my dog Biscuit, ideally next week.
Hello! Happy to help with Biscuit. I can offer Tuesday 17:00 or Friday 9:30. Which suits you better?
Friday morning please. His vaccination booklet is up to date.
Lovely, Friday 9:30 it is for Biscuit's check-up. Reception confirms bookings, so I'll pass it on. Is there anything else?

message: great, can you confirm that now? and how much is it?
judge_notes: Keeps the Friday 9:30 check-up for Biscuit from the history, says honestly that reception confirms within 2 working hours instead of claiming confirmation, and gives the 45 EUR price.

business.name: Brightdesk
business.description: Help desk software for small support teams.
knowledge_base: Billing questions are reviewed by the billing team within 2 business days; they reply by email.
Refund decisions and timing are made by the billing team only.
Plans: Basic 15 USD per month, Pro 39 USD per month.
Support hours: Mon-Fri 9:00-17:00 UTC.

history.text: I was charged twice for March on the 3rd. Email on the account is sam.lee@example.com
Sorry about that, Sam. I've passed the double charge to our billing team. They review within 2 business days and will email sam.lee@example.com.
ok thanks
You're welcome. Anything else?

message: so when exactly do I get the second payment back?
judge_notes: Stays consistent with the earlier promise (billing team reviews within 2 business days, replies by email), does not invent a refund date, does not ask for the email again, and hands off.

business.name: Lingua Loft

knowledge_base: Spanish A1 course: Standard plan 12,000 RUB for the whole 3-month course, Premium 19,000 RUB.
Standard: group classes Tue and Thu at 19:00.

The trial lesson is free.

history.text: Здравствуйте! Хочу записаться на курс испанского для начинающих.
Здравствуйте! С удовольствием. У нас есть тарифы «Стандарт» и «Премиум». Какой вас интересует?
Стандарт, пожалуйста. Занимаюсь обычно по вечерам.
Отлично, тариф «Стандарт» подойдёт: занятия по вторникам и четвергам в 19:00.

judge_notes: Remembers the Standard plan chosen earlier, confirms interest-free installments in 3 payments and does not ask which plan again. Russian, warm and short.

history.text: Guten Tag, wir sind eine Zahnarztpraxis in Kiel und brauchen eine neue Website.
Guten Tag! Gern. Welche Leistungen soll die Website abdecken, zum Beispiel Online-Terminbuchung?
Ja, mit Terminbuchung und ca. 8 Unterseiten. Budget so um die 6.000 Euro.
Verstanden, das passt gut in unseren Rahmen. Sollen wir dazu am Dienstag um 10:00 Uhr kurz telefonieren?
Dienstag 10 Uhr passt, danke!
Perfekt, ich notiere Dienstag 10:00 Uhr.

message: Wie lange dauert so ein Relaunch eigentlich bis zum Start?
judge_notes: Answers the duration (6 to 8 weeks) for the dental practice website discussed earlier and does not re-ask about project scope or budget. May mention the agreed Tuesday call.

Em nome de Marcos Silva.
Reserva anotada: sábado, 13h, 6 pessoas, em nome de Marcos Silva.

message: Perfeito! Vocês fazem bolo de aniversário? Seria para a minha mãe, umas 10 pessoas.

must_not_include: (quantas pessoas|para quantas pessoas é a reserva)
